definition.title: Data completeness and verification
definition.question: Which records are missing something the office needs?
definition.person_level_justification: A completeness report is worked through record by record. A count cannot be acted on — somebody has to open each named record and fill in what is missing.
definition.caution: This report names people, because it exists to be corrected record by record. Do not circulate it outside the office.

series.title: Records missing something
series.summary: 2 active records are missing at least one field. Each is named so it can be opened and corrected.

data.caution: This report names people, because it exists to be corrected record by record. Do not circulate it outside the office.
limits: A missing PhilSys number is not looked for: your account does not read PhilSys digits.
A missing mobile number is not looked for on a record under a protected sector: your account does not read their contact details.

disclosure.basis: A count below 5 can identify a person in a barangay of this size, so it is withheld rather than shown. The threshold follows common statistical disclosure practice; the MSWDO has not yet confirmed a figure of its own.
